reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) only generally describes thermal spray processes and HEA coatings, mentioning that particle size affects melting and oxidation, but provides no specific data or findings on the effect of switching from 15–45 μm to 45–75 μm feedstock on thickness, deposition efficiency, or oxidation.
